description: This file defines the SqlsrvManager class, a PHP class extending MssqlManager, providing SQL Server (sqlsrv) database management functionalities including connection handling, query execution, schema inspection, error handling, and transaction verification within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM ecosystem.

classes.name: SqlsrvManager
classes.description: A PHP class managing SQL Server database operations, extending MssqlManager, with capabilities for connection, querying, schema inspection, error handling, and transaction verification.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the SQL Server database using provided configuration options.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query, supporting array input and handling query timing and error checking.

methods.name: getFieldsArray
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about fields from a query result, optionally converting field names to lowercase.

methods.name: fetchRow
methods.description: Fetches a single row from a query result as an associative array, cleaning up varchar fields with a single space.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a string to a SQL Server compatible format based on the data type, with special handling for datetime.

methods.name: compareVarDefs
methods.description: Compares two variable definitions, with special handling for 'id' type fields to prevent unnecessary alterations.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the database connection and performs cleanup.

methods.name: freeDbResult
methods.description: Frees the database result resource.

methods.name: getConstraintSql
methods.description: Generates SQL for table constraints, ensuring a clustered index exists.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for a specified table.

methods.name: doesTableHaveAClusteredIndexDefined
methods.description: Checks if a table has a clustered index defined.

methods.name: doesTableHaveAFulltextIndexDefined
methods.description: Checks if a table has a fulltext index defined.

methods.name: changeColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for changing a column, including dropping fulltext indexes if necessary.

methods.name: truncateTableSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL statement to truncate a table.

methods.name: lastDbError
methods.description: Retrieves the last database error message, filtering out non-relevant messages.

methods.name: getDbInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the database server and client.

methods.name: verifyGenericQueryRollback
methods.description: Executes a data manipulation query within a transaction, then rolls back to verify correctness.

methods.name: verifyInsertInto
methods.description: Verifies an INSERT query by executing and rolling back.

methods.name: verifyUpdate
methods.description: Verifies an UPDATE query by executing and rolling back.

methods.name: verifyDeleteFrom
methods.description: Verifies a DELETE query by executing and rolling back.

methods.name: selectDb
methods.description: Selects a database to use.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the sqlsrv extension is available for use.
